prose.text: The gates are: - the three crates' unit tests; - the new behaviour's integration target in both layout modes; - the companions the diff moves: `stand_explore`, `stand_mcp_tools`, `stand_replay`, `stand_session_recording`,   `stand_act_spans` and `stand_cross_os_readings`, whose digests must not move; - escher-telemetry's own process checks: `telemetry_scrub`, `telemetry_drop` and `telemetry_panic_hook`, which show   that the sink prints what it printed; - seven_guis' `host_log` and `mcp_log`, which read a sink-installing host at trace with 0 needles (security ·   decision/no-screen-content-in-logs); - then the pre-push gate, `stand-repeat` (which the new `stand_` target joins) and the coverage leg (escher-driver's   97 % floor reads the new branches).

No boot-path touchpoint changes a binary's start, but escher-telemetry's `init` is the binaries' one install site (arch · decision/telemetry-one-install-site). `host_log` and `mcp_log` drive both binaries' roles under it, and stand in for the smoke. No live leg.

Each new check is controlled red-before-green (tests S5). After the steps are green, /implement runs four one-shot `gate.py control` runs, never entries: - The `catch_unwind` around the step in `execute.rs` removed: `stand_act_errors`' panic case reads failed. - The root mark comparison made always-equal in `caused.rs`: the `Err` case reads failed. - The capture layer's prefix test inverted in `capture.rs`: its unit table reads failed. - `take_step_reached` made to return the deduplicated record in `reached.rs`: its two-clicks case reads failed.
Each control names the edit's text and the case by its test name (gate-contract.md §Control).

The diff holds no OS-conditional site beyond the existing `cfg(unix)` gate on the recording case. The operator's hygiene, push and CI entries stand because the workspace leg builds the engine with `tracing` on (test-plan · decision/per-package-green-not-workspace-green). Engine records are excluded by prefix, so they never reach the capture under either build.
